info.title: GP247 REST API (v1 + v2)
info.description: REST API of gp247/core, gp247/front and gp247/shop. Every error body is {"error":1,"msg":"…","code":"…"}. Every response carries an X-Request-Id header (since 3.4.0; a valid id sent by the client is reused). A group turned off on the API management screen answers 404 with code api_disabled (since 3.3.1). See api-introduction.md.
